metadata.case_name: LIU CAIRONG v. PARKER CLEANING SERVICES COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: Cleaning worker (employed by the defendant); previously a farmer in the Mainland
plaintiff.education_level: 2 years of primary education (on the Mainland)

source: X-rays showed her fractures of the distal radius and ulna styloid process.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: fracture of the ulnar styloid process (left) with features of non-union at the ulnar styloid and slight separation of the distal radio-ulnar joint
injuries.body_part: left ulnar styloid process / left wrist
source: X-rays showed her fractures of the distal radius and ulna styloid process.
there were also features of non-union at the ulnar styloid and slight separation of the distal radio-ulnar joint.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

source: Dr Chan recorded in the letter that the plaintiff has history of depression and has been seen by Integrated Mental Health Program in July and August 2013. Allegedly she was suicidal and once even went to a roof of a building.

Dr Pao stated that the plaintiff was first known to the West Kowloon Psychiatric Centre in February 2014 because of low mood after the Accident. She was diagnosed to have a depressive episode secondary to he1r physical pain.

manifestations.description: residual pain, weakness and stiffness of the left wrist
difficulty on exertion required for pre-injury job
inconvenience when mopping floors and climbing a ladder
depressive episode with low mood and reported suicidal behaviour

treatments_received: immobilised by a plaster of Paris cast for four weeks

losses.description: PSLA (pain, suffering and loss of amenities) assessed at HK$200,000
Pre-trial loss of earnings of HK$35,227.50 (calculation: HK$6,100 x 105% x 5.5)
Loss of earning capacity (global award) HK$30,000
Value of service of caregiver (nominal) HK$5,000 covering period from the Accident to May 2010
Future medical expenses (public sector treatments) assessed at HK$5,000
Other special damages allowed in total HK$28,200 (includes physiotherapy HK$3,000, tonic food allowed HK$3,000, travel allowed HK$4,000 and other items to total HK$28,200)
